name: Search
description: Product search that finds what is being typed: by the start of a word, by a word's other forms, in every language a product is named in, by SKU, brand and the characteristics a shop marks as searchable — and by the keyboard layout a customer forgot to switch. Built as a registry of sources, so a meaning-based (vector) source can join later without changing the rest.

settings.label: Search in descriptions too
settings.help: The description counts least of all fields, but it does count: a word that is only in the description still finds the product, after everything that has it in the name. Off: only names, SKUs, brands and marked characteristics. Changing this rebuilds the index.

settings.label: Suggest from this many letters
settings.help: Fewer letters show the visitor's recent searches instead.

settings.label: Wait after the last keystroke, ms
settings.help: A request per keystroke is a request per letter; this waits until typing pauses.

settings.label: Dim the page while the search box is in use
settings.help: From a click into the box until it is left. The header stays lit — that is where the box is.

settings.label: "Add to cart" in the window
settings.help: A product already in the basket shows "In cart" instead, linking to it. A product that must be configured first gets "Choose", leading to its page.

options.toast: Show a notice in the corner
options.nothing: Nothing — the button turns into "In cart"

settings.label: After adding from the search window
Highlight what was typed
settings.help: The part of a name that matched is printed in bold — the start of a word, or the stem a form of the word shares with it.

settings.label: Load more products while scrolling the window
settings.help: The window starts with "Products in the window" and adds as many again each time it is scrolled to the end. Off: that many, then "All results".

settings.label: Search the site as well as the catalogue
settings.help: Information pages and whatever other modules offer (a blog). Switching it on puts a choice in the search box: the catalogue or the site. Off: the catalogue alone, and no choice.

settings.label: Search by default
settings.help: Until the visitor chooses; their choice is remembered for the visit.

settings.label: Searching the site shows products too
settings.help: Off: the site means its pages — the catalogue is the other choice. On: pages beside the catalogue's answers.

settings.label: Offer the categories of what was found
settings.help: Each narrows the search to that category and everything under it.

settings.label: Recent searches shown
settings.help: The visitor's own, kept in their session. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: Open the product when exactly one is found
settings.help: Only when the query matched as typed — never after reading it on another layout or as a typo.

settings.label: Count what is searched
settings.help: How often each query is searched, what it finds and what is chosen from it — per day, with no names, addresses or sessions. Marketing → Search → Statistics.

settings.label: Lift what people choose for a query
settings.help: A product opened from the answers to a query moves up for that query, among products that match it about as well.

settings.label: Popular searches in the window
settings.help: Searched queries that find something, beginning with what is typed; before anything is typed, the most searched ones. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: A query is popular from this many searches
settings.help: Over the last 30 days. Keeps one person's odd query out of everybody's window.
